title: Data source candidate
description: One evaluated candidate from the research-sources skill. One file per candidate at research/candidates/<slug>.json.

slug.description: Matches the filename stem and the memo filename stem.

granularity.description: e.g. tract, zcta, county, msa/cbsa, national.

history.description: How far back usable history goes.

cost.description: Confirmed free/paid, and any rate limit.

method.description: e.g. bulk CSV download, REST API, manual request.

license.description: License/ToS summary, including any restriction on commercial/product use.

fits_gap.description: What existing gap in sources.yaml / scoring this would fill, and where it would plug in.

correlation.description: Quantitative evaluation against FHFA tract HPI growth / Zillow ZORI, once app/research/evaluate_series.py exists. Null with a note until then.
